words.example: My reimbursement is pending until Finance checks the receipts.
words.exampleZh: 报销还待处理，要等财务核对收据。

words.example: Please complete the orientation checklist before you work alone.
words.exampleZh: 独立上岗前，请先完成入职介绍的核对清单。

words.example: Assign a timekeeper at the start so the briefing ends on time.
words.exampleZh: 开始时就指派计时员，简报才能按时结束。

words.example: We can reassign the visitor to another escort if you are in clinic.
words.exampleZh: 如果你在门诊，我们可以把这位访客改派给另一位陪同。

words.example: Reopen the complaint if the same problem happens again this week.
words.exampleZh: 如果同样的问题这周再发生，就把投诉重新打开。

words.example: Business continuity says outpatient registration must return within two hours.
words.exampleZh: 业务连续性要求门诊挂号在两小时内恢复。

words.example: High availability kept orders up when one app server died.
words.exampleZh: 一台应用服务器挂掉之后，高可用让医嘱仍然在线。

words.example: The failover cluster moved the database without dropping the open orders.
words.exampleZh: 故障转移集群把数据库迁走了，没有丢掉未完成的医嘱。

words.example: The load balancer kept sending traffic to a node that was already sick.
words.exampleZh: 负载均衡器还在把流量送到一个已经不正常的节点。

words.example: The reverse proxy returned an old page after we published the new portal.
words.exampleZh: 新门户发布之后，反向代理还在返回旧页面。
